python-engineering: Create, refactor or review Python code, CLI and public API behavior.
document-review: Modify document ingestion, field extraction, normalization or source evidence.
version-review: Build passage diff, align document versions, classify textual changes or update side-by-side review UI.
code-review: Review or re-review pull requests with reproducible behavior and tests.
llm-evaluation: Modify LLM providers, prompts, model calls, safety or evaluation suites.
